responsibility: Implements the GCC analyzer’s built-in modeling for specific known calls at the region_model layer. This file defines the call_details helper for extracting argument trees, symbolic values, string literals, and result lvalues from a gcall, and provides the per-function region_model handlers for library and analyzer intrinsics such as alloca, malloc/free, operator new/delete, memcpy/memset, strcpy, strlen, realloc, and __analyzer_* hooks. These routines update symbolic memory regions, create heap or stack allocation regions, conjure return values when needed, mark destinations unknown or filled, poison freed storage, trigger diagnostics or debugging descriptions, and thus supply the call-semantics glue between generic GIMPLE call execution in region-model.cc and checker/state-machine logic elsewhere in the analyzer.
